# NodeMaven Help Center

> A selection of Help resources from the NodeMaven Team

## English

### Get Started with NodeMaven

- [Create an Account](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9596394-create-an-account.md): Sign up, verify your email, choose a plan, and generate your first proxy.
- [How to add more traffic to your account](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9596734-how-to-add-more-traffic-to-your-account.md): Top up your current plan mid-cycle. Note that a top-up will not unfreeze frozen traffic.
- [How to upgrade your subscription](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9596774-how-to-upgrade-your-subscription.md): Upgrading moves you to a larger plan. Your remaining traffic transfers and your per-GB rate drops.
- [How to unfreeze your traffic](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9596806-how-to-unfreeze-your-traffic.md): Traffic freezes when your subscription ends. Only reactivating or starting a subscription releases it.
- [How to cancel your subscription](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9596822-how-to-cancel-your-subscription.md): Cancelling stops the next payment. Remaining traffic freezes and returns when you subscribe again.
- [MyBrocard](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9652281-mybrocard.md)
- [Proxy usage statistics](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9652267-proxy-usage-statistics.md): Your Dashboard shows traffic used, requests made and top domains. How to read them together to find where your traffic went.
- [Change password](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9652292-change-password.md)
- [The Sub-user feature](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/10225129-the-sub-user-feature.md): Create multiple proxy credentials under one main account
- [Changing the proxy password](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/10245794-changing-the-proxy-password.md)
- [How do monthly subscriptions work?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/10263215-how-do-monthly-subscriptions-work.md): A monthly subscription gives you set traffic each month, and unused traffic carries over when you renew.
- [How does Pay-as-you-go work?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/10290028-how-does-pay-as-you-go-work.md): Pay-as-you-go is a one-off purchase with no expiry. Traffic from a cancelled subscription does not transfer to it.
- [How to apply a coupon?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/10316413-how-to-apply-a-coupon.md)
- [Nodemaven referral program](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/10328111-nodemaven-referral-program.md)
- [Can I delete my account?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/13231432-can-i-delete-my-account.md)
- [Can I set a password after signing up with Google?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/13231469-can-i-set-a-password-after-signing-up-with-google.md)
- [Get started: How to start using a proxy for the first time](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/12864793-get-started-how-to-start-using-a-proxy-for-the-first-time.md)

### Rotating Residential & Mobile Proxies

- [Available locations](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9596833-available-locations.md): How to target countries, regions, cities, ZIPs and carriers with Residential and Mobile proxies, plus what the availability badges mean.
- [Session control](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9618865-session-control.md)
- [IP filter modes](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9597024-ip-filter-modes.md): The four IP filter modes, what each prioritises, and how they appear in your proxy username.
- [Getting Started with Residential and Mobile proxies](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9596871-getting-started-with-residential-and-mobile-proxies.md)
- [Authentication methods](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9979031-authentication-methods.md): Username and password, or IP whitelist. Where to find your proxy credentials and how to change them.
- [How to connect to proxies directly through Wi-Fi \(iPhone\)](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/11722280-how-to-connect-to-proxies-directly-through-wi-fi-iphone.md)
- [Set up a proxy directly on your Wi-Fi settings \(macOS\)](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/12982162-set-up-a-proxy-directly-on-your-wi-fi-settings-macos.md): With this method, all system and browser traffic will be routed through your proxy server without needing any extra software. It’s useful for IP masking, geo-testing, secure routing, or working wit...
- [Understanding your proxy string](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/12663937-understanding-your-proxy-string.md): What each part of your proxy string means, every parameter the dashboard can add, and worked examples.
- [IP Whitelist setup](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/13585316-ip-whitelist-setup.md): Let an approved IP address connect without a username and password. Residential and Mobile only.
- [Personal Setup](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/12872383-personal-setup.md)
- [ISP/Static Proxies](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/13165405-isp-static-proxies.md): ISP proxies \(Static Residential\) are dedicated IPs that stay the same for your whole order. Availability, connection format, billing and dashboard features.

- [Do your proxies support HTTP 2.0?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/14792983-do-your-proxies-support-http-2-0.md)

ISP IPs can become Residential traffic and Residential traffic can become ISP IPs. Support handles the request and confirms the rate.
- [Why do my Static Proxies show different locations on different IP checkers?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/14605116-why-do-my-static-proxies-show-different-locations-on-different-ip-checkers.md)

Compare targeting, billing, protocols and countries to pick the right one.

### Accounts and Billing

- [Where can I find my invoices?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/13231421-where-can-i-find-my-invoices.md): Invoices live in Billing. How to download them and how to get company details added.

- [Why am I getting charged for the subscription?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/10333701-why-am-i-getting-charged-for-the-subscription.md): Subscriptions renew automatically from the card kept on file. How to check the date and stop future charges.
- [What methods of payment do you offer?](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/9583579-what-methods-of-payment-do-you-offer.md): Card \(Visa and Mastercard\), YooMoney and MIR, or cryptocurrency. Only card subscriptions renew automatically.

### Scraping Browser

- [Scraping Browser API reference](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/16297672-scraping-browser-api-reference.md): Run a real Chrome browser on NodeMaven infrastructure through your proxy. Sessions, profiles, automation endpoints, and connection options.
- [Proxy & Profile Best Practices](https://docs.nodemaven.com/en/articles/16888101-proxy-profile-best-practices.md): How to configure proxies, browser profiles and the CAPTCHA solver in the Scraping Browser so your runs stay fast, consistent and unblocked.

Authentication, submitting questions, polling for results.
